sections.content: You know *es importante que* + subjunctive from A2 Unit 27. The same pattern says what governments should do: *es necesario que*, *hace falta que* and *conviene que* are also followed by the present subjunctive.

items.spanish: Es necesario que el Gobierno proteja los servicios públicos.
items.english: It is necessary that the government protect public services.

items.spanish: Es importante que se garanticen ciertos derechos.
items.english: It is important that certain rights be guaranteed.

items.spanish: Hace falta que las instituciones respondan a las necesidades de la ciudadanía.
items.english: Institutions need to respond to citizens' needs.

items.spanish: Conviene que el Gobierno mejore el transporte público.
items.english: It is advisable for the government to improve public transport.

sections.content: When you do not want to name who should act, use the *se* passive you know from B1 Unit 6 inside the subjunctive clause: *es importante que se garanticen ciertos derechos*.
